rows.grounds: sandhi fusion potādeḥ + cet; pota-ādi as examples of external means
instrument through which something is observed or effected
locative absolute indicating the condition of being observed
abstract state of functioning as an instrumental means like a lamp

items.question: How can external objects like boats serve as instrumental means analogous to a lamp in revealing awareness?
premises: A boat and similar objects can function as means in observation.
When such a means is observed, its instrumental role becomes evident.
A lamp and similar aids exemplify the state of being an instrumental means.
items.inference: Therefore, external objects like boats share the same instrumental status as a lamp in making awareness manifest.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic subject of dīpādyupāyatā is implicit from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: If, by means of something like a boat, it is seen, then it has the status of being a means, just like a lamp and similar aids.
